data_policy.content_storage: factual metadata, short evidence labels and original gameplay paraphrases only
data_policy.rights_note: Public visibility alone does not establish republication rights. No full descriptions, images, video or game assets are stored.

scope.sampling_rule: First 10 cards in the homepage Top games in US today section in DOM order. Inspect detail pages for the first five only.

limitations: Not a complete catalog, global ranking, representative sample or measured heat score.
One snapshot cannot establish growth, velocity, retention or a trend.
Homepage US label describes the observed surface; user location was not requested or inferred.
Only five detail pages were inspected; remaining five records are discovery-only.
Vote counts are rounded and their accumulation window is unspecified. Ratings explicitly reference the last six months. Do not calculate the rating from vote totals.
No game-level plays, active users or concurrent users were observed. Missing values are null, not zero.
Detail pages may load embedded games automatically; no gameplay controls, videos, downloads, login or hidden APIs were used.
Date labels are preserved with their displayed precision; release-date disagreements are retained rather than silently normalized.

source_extensions.page_title_raw: Hot Games This Month on CrazyGames
source_extensions.time_window_evidence_raw: These games are blowing up in the last 24 hours
source_extensions.time_window_interpretation: Visible page introduction says last 24 hours while page title says This Month. Both retained; methodology and exact aggregation window unverified.

limitations: Display position is not an official numeric rank.
The page labels these games hot but exposes no underlying growth, plays, users or scoring formula in the inspected listing.
Visible last-24-hours text conflicts with the monthly document title; do not silently choose an aggregation window.
Discovery-only batch: no rating, votes, developer or gameplay details collected.
Only the first ten cards were retained, not the entire page.
Game URLs were observed on cards; destination detail pages were not opened in this batch.
